blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Finishing the Code of Conduct (COC) in the South China Sea will now be in Singapore’s hands, as Philippine authorities lacked the time needed to wrap up several issues, Foreign Affairs Secretary Maria Theresa Lazaro said on Sunday. Despite this, Lazaro said in a press briefing at the International Media Center for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit that the Philippines considers the progress in the COC one of the successes that came out of the country’s hosting of the biannual tilt.
